dialogue_texts: This manor is positively drenched in that glohm filth.
It's a heavy, unrefined weight like a banquet where the guests have forgotten how to speak.
Please... just go away. The shadows are the only things that don't make demands.
I don't need a visitor, and I certainly don't need a witness to my peace.
Ah, so this is a glohmed individual. A Lunarian maid, no less.
You look like a beautiful doll trapped in a very dusty cage. Is this the peace the Order promised you?
Glohm? I know nothing of such things.
I only know the grey despair that has finally silenced the world's noise.
Even the moonlight feels like an intrusion now.
How tragic. You've closed your heart so tightly you've even forgotten the name of your own chains.
As an Empress, I find this lack of awareness... tedious.
Tedious? You speak as if you have authority over my silence!
If you won't let me be alone, then I'll bury you in the weight of this stillness!
Eternity is much longer than your little tantrum.
If you won't listen to reason, I suppose I shall have to use my Branch of Hourai to crack that shell of yours.
If you love the moonlight so much, I'll let it be the last thing you see before the dust swallows your eternity!
